iti108:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti108:2.1: ye keci bhikkhave bhikkhū kuhā thaddhā lapā siṅgī unnaḷā asamāhitā, na me te bhikkhave bhikkhū māmakā,
iti108:2.2: apagatā ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā. na ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjanti.
iti108:2.3: ye ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhū nikkuhā nillapā dhīrā atthaddhā susamāhitā, te kho me bhikkhave bhikkhū māmakā,
iti108:2.4: anapagatā ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā. te bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmiṃ ca dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjantī’ti.
iti108:5.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
